title: site.py: Duplicate path registration overwrites SentMessagesResource
description: Lines 192-193 register both SentMessagesResource and SentMessageDetailsResource at the same path ["msg", "sent"]. aiocoap's Site.add_resource replaces existing resources, so SentMessagesResource is overwritten. Since SentMessageDetailsResource.render_get() returns NOT_FOUND when uri_path is empty (line 186-187 of messaging.py), GET /msg/sent returns 404 instead of the sent messages list. The SentMessageDetailsResource should likely be registered at a sub-path or the routing logic needs restructuring.
close_reason: Fixed: Removed duplicate path registration in site.py. SentMessageDetailsResource now handles both collection (GET /msg/sent) and detail (GET /msg/sent/{id}) requests via PathCapable routing.
